mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 51 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School, under a waning crescent moon.

The City of Verona is preparing for fall leaf collection which runs through December. Please note that the new leaf vacuum truck can only collect loose leaves, so keep your piles free of sticks, rocks, and debris.

There is plenty to do this week in town. We have trivia today at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.
On October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested after being found in possession of a stolen firearm and having an active probation warrant.
You can look forward to Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie as today's flavor of the day at the Verona location, which opens today at 10:00 AM.
